description: Environmental Defense Fund publishes a spatially explicit methane-emissions inventory for oil and gas activities in the Permian Basin. The dataset combines recent facility-scale measurements with oil and gas activity information for 2021, covering western Texas and southern New Mexico on a 0.01-degree grid. Zenodo lists one NetCDF inventory file, openly accessible and free under CC-BY-4.0. The values are constructed inventory estimates, not continuous measurements of each facility. That limitation matters when applying them to short-lived operational events or interpreting grid cells as individual sources. The inventory can provide a baseline for oil-and-gas emission mitigation scenarios and atmospheric dispersion calculations linked to infrastructure operations. It complements the catalogued OGIM asset-location database, data-ogim-oil-gas-infrastructure-mapping, with a regional emissions estimate derived for a specific year. The file was not downloaded and the measurement-to-grid allocation was not reproduced.
